error[L0346]: only a C record's last field may be a zero-length array

7 |     name: [0]u8
  |     ^^^^^^^^^^^

6 | early: type = layout(c) struct
  |                         ^^^^^^ this C layout
  = note: D413: `[0]T` is C's flexible array member, whose elements follow the record; move it last or give the array a length
error[L0346]: a record ending in a flexible array member is not a field of a C record

   |     ^^^^^^^^^^^^
  --> ../tests/fixtures/negative/flexible-member-placement/program.ldn:11:26
   |

   |                          ^^^^^^ this C layout
  = note: D413: its trailing elements would overlap the field after it; hold a pointer to the record instead
